# Sandman Research

> Daily macro research briefings for serious traders — prop, discretionary, systematic, and allocators. Macro context before decisions, not signals.

Sandman Research operates The Macro Desk: a private research platform delivering daily macro briefings, key market levels, economic calendar weighting, and end-of-session desk debriefs. The product is research and education — not trade alerts, not financial advice. Members use the desk as a structured pre-decision routine.

The desk runs the same four-step loop every market day: Frame (macro backdrop), Locate (key levels and scenarios), Track (intraday catalyst and risk tone shifts), Debrief (post-session review). The format does not change across regimes — that consistency is the core value.

Plans are Monthly at €49/mo (core research platform), Quarterly at €129/quarter — €43/mo effective (adds education, weekly live sessions, priority Q&A), and Annual at €499/year — €42/mo effective (adds direct access to Sandman; best per-month rate). Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions are processed via Whop.

## Core pages

- [Homepage](https://sandman-research.com/): Single-page overview — sample briefing, the four-step research loop, plan comparison, FAQ, and sample request
- [The Briefing](https://sandman-research.com/#inside): A real Macro Desk briefing sample in full
- [Method](https://sandman-research.com/#method): The four-step research loop (Frame → Locate → Track → Debrief)
- [Pricing](https://sandman-research.com/#pricing): Plan comparison — Monthly, Quarterly, Annual — each with a 7-day free trial

## What The Macro Desk delivers

- Daily Macro Briefing: pre-cash read of macro backdrop and cross-asset conditions, delivered ~06:30 ET every session
- Key Market Levels: proprietary, high-precision levels across the multi-asset book with structure and scenario context
- Economic Calendar: filtered policy and data events with desk editorial weighting — not a raw feed
- Desk Debriefs: end-of-session reviews separating signal from noise, delivered ~16:30 ET
- Education and Sessions: live desk Q&A sessions for Quarterly and Annual members
- News Terminal (in development): real-time news terminal, access rolled out to Annual members first

## Who it is for

Prop firm traders, discretionary and systematic desks, multi-strats, allocators, and family offices who need a clean macro routine before the open. The desk is for professionals who value concise context over volume, and a repeatable process over reactive commentary.
